glasses_felix: Pattern of error: High volatility between desk_b1 and coffee_table_l1. Day 21 data shows it was at desk_b1 at 09:05 and coffee_table_l1 at 10:13. Next time: Check desk_b1 for early morning queries (before 10:00); switch to coffee_table_l1 for late morning/afternoon. Do not assume it stays on the shelf.

tablet_felix: Pattern of error: Inconsistent tracking between desk_b1, coffee_table_l1, and kitchen_table_k1. Day 19 data remains the best guide: coffee_table_l1 for afternoon (12:00-16:00) and kitchen_table_k1 for late afternoon/evening (after 16:00). Avoid desk_b1 for these timeframes.

mug_felix: Pattern of error: Erratic movement between coffee_table_l1 and kitchen_table_k1 in the late afternoon. Day 21 data shows it was at coffee_table_l1 at 15:50 and 17:28, but moved to kitchen_table_k1 by 18:00. Next time: Check coffee_table_l1 for queries between 15:00 and 17:30; switch to kitchen_table_k1 for queries after 17:30.

glass_felix: Pattern of error: Defaulting to nightstand_b1 for late night queries. Day 20 data shows it was at counter_k1 at 21:28. Next time: Check counter_k1 for late night queries; nightstand_b1 is incorrect.

book_felix: No new errors today. Keep existing note: Check coffee_table_l1 first for books.

razor_felix: Pattern of error: Defaulting to medicine_cabinet_ba1 for morning queries. Day 20 data shows it was at bathroom_shelf_ba1 at 08:11. Next time: Check bathroom_shelf_ba1 for morning queries; medicine_cabinet_ba1 is incorrect.
